name: Angry Squirrel
flavor: He has a tiny sword and a big grudge.

name: Squire Gregory
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Has carried the same shield since Tuesday. It is now Thursday.

name: Eager Recruit
text: Hustle.
flavor: First day. Already swinging. HR has been notified.

name: Good Boy
flavor: He guards. He is a very good boy. 14/10.

name: Archer Who Missed
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: He never misses. Except that one time. We do not talk about it.

name: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
flavor: The disguise is just a hat. A very convincing hat.

name: Sir Falls-A-Lot
flavor: Knighted for bravery. Unknighted twice for falling off his horse.

name: Brute Force
flavor: Solves every problem by hitting it. Undefeated record.

name: Ogre Achiever
flavor: Top of his class. The class was Smashing Things 101.

name: Giant Toddler
flavor: He is just big for his age. He is three.

name: Golem the Rock
flavor: Made of rock. Great at parties. Terrible at swimming.

name: Dave the Dragon
flavor: Breathes fire. Files taxes. A regular guy.

name: Professional Meat Shield
text: Bouncer.
flavor: His job description is just the word 'stand'.

name: Wallace the Wall
text: Bouncer.
flavor: He is just a wall. But he is YOUR wall.

name: Gated Community
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Residents only. HOA fees are brutal.

name: Charger the Charger
text: Hustle.
flavor: Charges. That is it. That is the whole card.

name: Cavalry's Here!
text: Hustle.
flavor: Arrives dramatically. Always late to everything else.

name: Dr. Feelgood
text: Entrance: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: Not a real doctor. But the vibes are immaculate.

name: Zapper the Unlicensed Electrician
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: No permit. No fear. Slightly singed eyebrows.

name: Nosy Nancy
text: Entrance: Draw a card.
flavor: She knows everything about everyone. Especially you.

name: Middle Manager
text: Entrance: Summon a 1/1 Kevin, the Intern.
flavor: His real talent is delegating. Kevin, the Intern, will handle it.

name: Fireball of Mild Inconvenience
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy.
flavor: It is hot. It is annoying. Your eyebrows are gone.

name: Healing Light (As Seen On TV)
text: Restore 5 Health to your Boss. Draw a card.
flavor: Results may vary. Side effects include glowing.

name: Wisdom From a Fortune Cookie
text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: 'You will draw two cards.' The cookie knew.

name: Nova the Drama Queen
text: Deal 2 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: She affects EVERYONE. No exceptions. It is her moment.
design_note: Re-costed to 4 per scaled class premium (Batch 2 review).

name: Written Out of the Will
text: Destroy an enemy Crew member.
flavor: She didn't get mad. She got a notary.
design_note: Re-costed to 4 per scaled class premium (Batch 2 review; destroy is unscalable).

name: Roulette Wheel of Regret
text: Deal 2-5 damage to a random enemy Crew member. If there are none, hit the enemy Boss.
flavor: Spin it. What could go wrong? Everything. Everything could go wrong.

name: Paid Off
text: Take control of a random enemy Crew member with 2 or less Attack.
flavor: Everyone has a price. Yours was low.
design_note: Re-costed to 3 per scaled class premium (Batch 2 review; steal_weak is unscalable).

name: Oops, Wrong Hand!
text: Swap hands with your opponent.
flavor: You have their cards now. They have yours. Awkward.
design_note: Re-costed to 2 per scaled class premium (Batch 2 review; swap_hands is unscalable).

name: Coin Flip of Destiny
text: Heads: Draw 2 cards. Tails: Draw a card and take 2 damage.
flavor: Heads: you win. Tails: you lose. The coin is also cursed.

name: Sleepy Sloth
flavor: He will get to it. Eventually. Maybe.
design_note: 3/1 split dedups from Angry Squirrel / Office Plant (1-mana 2/2) and Squire Gregory (1/3 Taunt).

name: Office Plant
flavor: It does nothing. Proudly. For years.
design_note: 1/3 split dedups from Angry Squirrel (2/2) and Sloth (3/1).

name: Confused Tourist
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Is this the bus to the dungeon? Asking for a friend.
design_note: Taunt dedups from Wolf (3/2) and Guard Dog (2/3); flavor: he stands in the way taking photos.

name: Substitute Teacher
text: Hustle.
flavor: She has no idea what lesson this is. Neither do you.
design_note: Charge dedups from Wolf (3/2), Guard Dog (2/3) and Tourist (2/2 Taunt); flavor: she charges down the hall.

name: Very Loud Librarian
flavor: SHHH! ...Sorry. Force of habit.
design_note: 2/4 split dedups from Knight (3/3 vanilla).

name: Tax Auditor
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: He has found some irregularities in your board.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Professional Napper
text: Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Rude Alarm Clock.
flavor: Wakes up only when knocked out.
design_note: Token: Rude Alarm Clock, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: Disappointed Wizard
flavor: He expected more from you. From everyone, really.

name: Part-Time Dragon
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Breathes fire on weekends. Files taxes on weekdays.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Haunted Vending Machine
text: Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Angry Snack.
flavor: It ate your dollar. Now it wants your soul.
design_note: Token: Angry Snack, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: Retired Superhero
flavor: He saved the world. Now he saves coupons.
design_note: 4/5 split dedups from Giant Toddler (5/4 vanilla).

name: Giant Sandwich
text: Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Crumb.
flavor: Falls apart under pressure. Literally.
design_note: Token: Crumb, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: Landlord's Landlord
text: Bouncer.
flavor: He collects rent from the concept of rent.
design_note: 4/4 split dedups from Agatha Shield (4/5 Taunt) and Golem (5/4 Taunt).

name: Ancient Refrigerator
flavor: Hums ominously. Contains mysteries from 1987.
design_note: 4/6 split dedups from Dave the Dragon (5/5 vanilla Legendary).

name: Suburban Dad
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: He will grill your Crew member. Literally. Come over Sunday.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: The Last Slice
text: Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Nobody wanted it. Now nobody can have it.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Gary, Keeper of the Leftovers
text: Entrance: Deal 3 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: He has seen things. Smelled things. He remains.
design_note: New neutral Legendary: given an effect per §5 rule (c) - every Legendary needs an effect unique at that value in its class. Stats 4/4 keep total 11 (7-cost neutral budget-1).

name: Goblin Firecracker
text: Bouncer. Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: He is the firecracker. He has accepted this.
design_note: Extreme skew (3/1): a firecracker; pops hard, pops once. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Tiny Bomber
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Small goblin. Big boom. Short career.
design_note: Charge -> Taunt (Batch 2 review dedup: Recruit is the 2/1 Charge copy; Scout is the 1/2 Charge copy). A tiny bomber draws fire.

name: Fuse Lighter
text: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the enemy Boss.
flavor: Lights the fuse. Runs. That is the whole job.
design_note: Minion-only target (Batch 2 review dedup).

name: Firecracker
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: POP! ...That is it. That is the Trick.

name: Sparkler
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Pretty. Festive. On fire.
design_note: Charge removed to dedup (all 1-cost Charge splits taken by Scout/Tiny Bomber/Match); Battlecry damage keeps the spark theme.

name: Goblin With a Match
text: Hustle. Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: What could possibly go wrong? Everything. Ask the village.
design_note: Battlecry added (Batch 2 review dedup: Scout is the vanilla Charge copy; Recruit is the 2/1 Charge copy).

name: Powder Keg Gremlin
text: Hustle. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Sits on a keg. The keg is also a gremlin. It is gremlins all the way down.
design_note: Deathrattle added (Batch 2 review dedup: Scout is the vanilla Charge copy; Recruit is the 2/1 Charge copy). The keg explodes when destroyed.

name: Bottle Rocket
text: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: It goes where it wants. Usually toward someone.

name: Goblin Scout (Bravery Optional)
text: Hustle.
flavor: Scouts ahead. Screams. Runs back. Report complete.
design_note: 1/3 split dedups from Tiny Bomber (3/1 Charge) and Match (2/2 Charge).

name: Boomlet
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: He is not the boom. He is the boomlet. There is a difference.

name: Sparky, the Living Fuse
text: Entrance: 1 damage to an enemy Crew member. Final Bow: 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: He is a fuse. He is alive. He is fine with it.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): at most 2 Legendaries per class use the signature; Sparky became a Battlecry+Deathrattle combo.

name: Goblin Demolition Crew
text: Hustle.
flavor: Three goblins. One sledgehammer. Zero permits.
design_note: Extreme skew (1/3): the demo crew holds the line while the fuse burns. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Dynamite Goblin
text: Hustle.
flavor: Holds dynamite. Runs at you. Do the math.
design_note: Extreme skew (3/1): dynamite hits hard and goes out fast. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Firework Fanatic
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Every day is the Fourth of July. Every day.
design_note: Extreme skew (3/1): a fanatic who charges in swinging. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Molotov Cocktail (Non-Alcoholic)
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: It is just juice. Spicy juice. Flaming juice.
design_note: Minion-only target (Batch 2 review dedup: Fireball is the any-enemy copy).

name: Goblin Pyromaniac
flavor: Arson is a hobby. Arson is a lifestyle. Arson is a calling.
design_note: Extreme skew (4/1): a pyro who burns bright and dies fast. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Sapper
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Digs under your board. Pops up. Surprise!

name: Flash Powder
text: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: Everyone blinks. Everyone regrets blinking.
design_note: Class premium: AoE value not increased (AoE jumps are not +1 mana worth); value kept per §2B table.

name: Goblin Grenadier
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Throws grenades. Sometimes in the right direction.
design_note: Wall skew (1/3): survives the Battlecry it throws; trades poorly by design. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Wildfire
text: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: It burns what it burns. You do not get a say.

name: Boom Squad
text: Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: One goes down. The other two get ideas.

name: Kaboom Courier
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Delivers packages. The packages deliver themselves. Explosively.
design_note: Minion-only target (Batch 2 review dedup: Fanatic is the any-enemy copy).

name: Grunk's Left Boot
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: The right boot is lost. The left boot is angry.
design_note: Minion-only target (Batch 2 review dedup).

name: Detonation Dan
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: His name is Dan. His hobby is detonation. He sees no conflict.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): Battlecry+Deathrattle combo.

name: Goblin Wrecking Ball
text: Hustle.
flavor: He IS the wrecking ball. He came in like one.

name: Blastmaster
text: Hustle.
flavor: Master of blasts. Student of bigger blasts.

name: Arsonist Apprentice
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Still learning. The city is still learning too.

name: Fireball, Extra Spicy
text: Deal 5 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Warning: may cause eyebrows. And everything else.

name: Goblin Torchbearer
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Carries the torch. Drops the torch. Runs.

name: Powder Goblin
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Not a monkey. Just very powdery. And very fast.
design_note: Stat split 3/1 (Full-set review): the 2/2 split would duplicate Zapper in-pool; 3 Attack keeps the Battlecry as the threat.

name: Chain Explosion
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: One goes off. They all go off. That is the chain.
design_note: Glass-cannon skew (3/1): the AoE Battlecry is the whole card; the body dies to everything.

name: Goblin Fire Brigade (Arson Division)
text: Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: They put out fires. By starting bigger fires.

name: Boombox
text: At the start of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Plays music. Loudly. Explosively. It is a boombox.

name: Professor Kablooey
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: PhD in Kablooey. Thesis: also Kablooey.
design_note: Stat split 1/3 (Full-set review): the 2/2 split would duplicate Zapper in-pool; 1 Attack keeps the Battlecry as the threat.

name: Aunt Dynamite
text: Final Bow: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Everyone's favorite aunt. Everyone's least favorite explosion.

name: The Goblin King (Self-Appointed)
text: Entrance: Deal 4 damage, split randomly among enemy characters.
flavor: He appointed himself. No one has objected. Yet.
design_note: Signature keeper (Batch 2 review); -1 stat for scaled premium.

name: Siege Goblin
text: Hustle.
flavor: Knocks on your door. With a battering ram. Politely.

name: Bomb Chucker
text: Hustle.
flavor: Chucks bombs. Chucks them far. Chucks them at you.

name: Inferno Imp
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Small. Hot. Extremely pleased with himself.

name: Goblin War Machine (Out of Warranty)
text: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: Warranty void. Parts missing. Still works. Mostly.

name: Boom-Boom Betty
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: She goes boom. Then boom again. That is why there are two booms.
design_note: Glass-cannon skew (4/2): the AoE Battlecry is the whole card; the body dies to everything.

name: Grunk Jr., the Heir
text: Entrance: Deal 5 damage, split randomly among enemy characters.
flavor: Heir to the boom throne. Heir to the safety violations.
design_note: Signature keeper (Batch 2 review: at most 2 Legendaries per class use the signature); +1 stat for scaled premium.

name: Fireworks Finale
text: Bouncer. Entrance: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: The grand finale. The grandest. The finalest.
design_note: Redesigned (Batch 2 review): the 0-attack Deathrattle-only pattern failed twice (-11, then -4.4); now a Taunt Battlecry body.

name: Goblin Artillery
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Fires goblins. At goblins. Goblin-ception.

name: Megabomb
text: Final Bow: Deal 2 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: It is a mega bomb. It does mega bomb things.

name: The Big One
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: It is big. It is the one. It is The Big One.

name: Grandma Boom (Retired)
text: Entrance: Deal 3 damage to an enemy Crew member. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: She knits. She bakes. She explodes. In that order.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): Battlecry+Deathrattle combo.

name: Soup Ladle (Weaponized)
text: Encore.
flavor: It serves soup. It serves justice. Same motion.
design_note: Extreme skew (1/3): a ladle that blocks more than it batters. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Chicken Soup (Magic)
text: Tip Jar.
flavor: Cures everything. Even this.
design_note: 3/2 split dedups from Dr. Feelgood (2/3 Battlecry heal 3, neutral).

name: Doily of Protection
text: Stunt Double. Entrance: Restore 2 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It is lace. It is protective. Do not question it.
design_note: Heal 5 (not 3) to dedup from Medic (2/3 heal 3) and Chicken (3/2 heal 3).

name: Grandma's Cookies
text: Bouncer. At the end of your turn, restore 2 Health to your Boss.
flavor: The recipe card is inside. So is another card.
design_note: Changed from draw-2 spell (draw belongs to Presto) to heal minion; heal rule bans pure heal spells above 1 mana.

name: Ladle to the Face
text: Stage Fright an enemy Crew member. Draw a card.
flavor: Agatha does not miss. The ladle does not miss.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Casserole Dish
text: Whenever your Boss is healed, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: It holds casserole. It holds grudges. It holds the line.
design_note: Extreme skew (3/1): a dish that hits back. (Batch 2 review re-cost.)

name: Timmy, the Favorite Grandson
text: Entrance: Destroy all damaged enemy Crew.
flavor: He brings soup. He brings joy. He brings trouble for your Crew.
design_note: Legendary: Agatha signature effect (destroy_damaged).

name: Soup Kitchen Volunteer
text: Bouncer. Whenever your Boss is healed, gain +1/+1.
flavor: Serves soup. Judges you. Silently.

name: Reinforced Doily
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Double-stitched. Double-protective. Double-doily.

name: Meatloaf Monday
text: Entrance: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It is Monday. It is meatloaf. It heals you.

name: Agatha's Rolling Pin
text: Deal 5 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: For rolling dough. And rolling enemies.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Casserole of Consequences
text: Final Bow: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: Eat it now, or face the consequences. The consequences are healing.

name: Grandma's Knitting
text: Whenever your Boss is healed, give a random friendly Crew member +1/+1.
flavor: She knits sweaters. She knits fate. Same yarn.
design_note: Taunt removed to dedup (all 3-cost Taunt splits taken by Reinforced/Boris/Volunteer); heal rider keeps Agatha identity.

name: Soup Dumpling
text: Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Soup Spoon.
flavor: Pops. Delicious. A spoon emerges.
design_note: Token: Soup Spoon, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: Ladle of Justice
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Justice is served. With soup.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Boris the Soup Dragon
text: Bouncer. Whenever this takes damage and survives, restore 1 Health to your Boss.
flavor: Breathes soup. Not fire. Soup. It is worse.

name: Aunt Marge's Revenge
text: Final Bow: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Marge remembers. Marge always remembers.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Soup Pot (Large)
text: Entrance: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It is large. It is soup. It is a pot.
design_note: Taunt removed to dedup from Iron Ladle (4/4 Taunt) / Bouncer (3/5 Taunt) / Fine China (5/3 Taunt); heal rider keeps Agatha identity.

name: Iron Ladle
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Heavy. Iron. Unimpressed by your attack.

name: Grandma's Medicine
text: Entrance: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: Tastes awful. Works perfectly. That is the deal.

name: Casserole Cannon
text: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: Fires casseroles. The recoil is tremendous. The flavor is worse.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): damage 5 cannot price at +1 at cost 4 (table capped) and cost-1 duplicates Pin; became Agatha's cheap AoE-1.

name: Leftover Lasagna
text: Tip Jar.
flavor: Better the second day. Better the third day. Best when it explodes.

name: Soup Kitchen Bouncer
text: Bouncer.
flavor: No soup for you. No entry for you. No.

name: Agatha's Disappointed Sigh
text: Entrance: Heckle an enemy Crew member.
flavor: The sigh heard around the world. Whole crews tremble.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Casserole Carol
text: Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Casserole Dish.
flavor: She brings the casserole. The casserole brings friends.
design_note: Token: Casserole Dish, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: The Good China
text: Bouncer. Stunt Double.
flavor: Only used for special occasions. This is a special occasion. You are doomed.

name: Grandma's Wrath (Mild)
text: Deal 2 damage to ALL Crew.
flavor: Mild wrath. Everyone suffers. Equally. Fairly.
design_note: Restored to 4 (Batch 2 v2 re-test: +4.6/copy at 3 mana after the cost-1 fallback; explicit exception to the fallback).

name: Soup Golem
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Made of soup. Held together by spite. And soup.
design_note: Converted from vanilla to Taunt (vanilla cap); Taunt is the premium point.

name: Grandma's Shield (Doily)
text: Bouncer.
flavor: It is a doily. It is a shield. It is both. Fear it.

name: Seconds, Anyone?
text: Entrance: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: Seconds are mandatory. Thirds are encouraged.

name: Ladle Storm
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: It is raining ladles. Hallelujah.
design_note: Changed from AoE-2 spell (exact duplicate of Nova) to Battlecry AoE-1 minion; Agatha keeps board-clear identity via Nova.

name: Casserole of Doom
text: Final Bow: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Doom is served. Doom is delicious.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Bobby, the Favorite Grandchild (Allegedly)
text: Entrance: Restore 5 Health to your Boss. Final Bow: Summon a 1/1 Casserole Dish.
flavor: She has no favorites. Except this one. Do not tell the others.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): Battlecry+Deathrattle combo. Token: Casserole Dish, 1/1 minion, no keywords.

name: Soup Dragon (Adult)
flavor: Breathes soup. Adult soup. The strong stuff.

name: Grandma's Fortress (Doily)
text: Bouncer. Vibe: Your other Crew have +1 Health.
flavor: A fortress made of doilies. Impenetrable. Mostly.

name: Eternal Casserole
text: At the end of your turn, restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It never runs out. Neither does Grandma.

name: Ladle of Annihilation
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: It annihilates. Gently. With soup.
design_note: Minion-only damage, priced at the any-enemy table rate.

name: Agatha's Secret Recipe
text: Final Bow: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: The secret ingredient is love. And 5 Health.

name: The Last Casserole
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member. Final Bow: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: There is only one. There has always been only one.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): Battlecry+Deathrattle combo.

name: Grandma's Soup Pot (Enormous)
text: Bouncer.
flavor: It feeds a village. It could feed an army. It feeds your doom.

name: Ironclad Doily
text: Bouncer.
flavor: Iron. Doily. Iron doily. It does not make sense. It does not need to.

name: Casserole Titan
text: Entrance: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: A titan. Made of casserole. It is as ridiculous as it sounds.

name: Agatha's Wrath (Full)
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew.
flavor: Full wrath. No survivors. No seconds.
design_note: Agatha AoE-1 Battlecry; stats at scaled premium (Batch 2 review).

name: The Soup That Ate the Village
text: Bouncer. Entrance: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It started as soup. It became... more.
design_note: Stabilizing effect added (Batch 2 review): Battlecry heal 5.

name: Grandma Agatha, Unleashed
text: Entrance: Destroy all damaged enemy Crew. Final Bow: Restore 5 Health to your Boss.
flavor: She has removed her apron. Run.
design_note: Signature keeper, paired (Batch 2 review): Battlecry destroy_damaged + Deathrattle AoE-1; destroy_damaged repriced 4->2.

name: The Biggest Casserole
text: Entrance: Restore 3 Health to your Boss.
flavor: It feeds everyone. It judges everyone. It is the biggest.

name: Soupocalypse
text: Entrance: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy. Final Bow: Deal 4 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: The end of soup. The beginning of soup. Soup forever.
design_note: Reworked (Batch 2 review): Battlecry+Deathrattle combo (no longer destroy_damaged).

name: Last Firework
text: Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: It saved the best for last. The last is an explosion.
design_note: Replaces Emergency Explosives (cut: dead card - costs a card, nets 0 mana).

name: Cantrip
text: Draw a card. Deal 1 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: The first Trick every apprentice learns. The last one too.

name: Wild Spark
text: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: It went somewhere. Probably fine.

name: Scroll Reader
text: Entrance: Draw a card.
flavor: She reads every scroll. Out loud. All of them.

name: Reckless Apprentice
text: Entrance: Draw a card. Take 2 damage.
flavor: Homework is dangerous.

name: Misfire
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: He was aiming at the target. The target was not the target.

name: Helpful Familiar
text: Final Bow: Draw a card.
flavor: It fetches scrolls. And snacks. Mostly snacks.

name: Mana Potion
text: Gain 1 Mana this turn only.
flavor: Side effects include: more mana.

name: Living Ink
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: It is ink. It is alive. It has opinions.

name: Cram Session

flavor: New game. New victims.

name: The Whale
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Bets big. Loses bigger. Comes back anyway.

name: Big Bessie, the Wheel
text: Final Bow: Swap the Attack and Health of a random enemy Crew member.
flavor: The wheel turns. So do your stats.

name: Croupier
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: No more bets. Except this one.

name: The Fixer
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy Crew member.
flavor: Fixes games. Fixes people. Fixes everything.

name: Oddsmaker
text: Entrance: 2 damage to a random enemy. Final Bow: 1 damage to a random enemy Crew member.
flavor: Sets the odds. Breaks the odds.

name: Lucky Seven
text: Whenever a random effect fires, deal 1 damage to the enemy Boss.
flavor: Seven. Lucky. Until it isn't.

name: Pit Boss
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Runs the pit. Runs the game. Runs you.

name: Cheat
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Cheat. Win. Repeat.

name: Madame Misfortune
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to ALL enemy Crew. Final Bow: Deal 2 damage to an enemy Crew member.
flavor: Your fortune: everyone suffers. Including you.

name: Whale Hunter
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Hunts whales. The whales hunt back.

name: Loaded Dice
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Final Bow: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy Crew member.
flavor: Definitely not loaded. Definitely.

name: The Big Score
text: Entrance: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: The big score. Finally.

name: Casino Magnate
text: Entrance: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
flavor: Owns the casino. Owns the game.

name: The House Always Wins
text: Entrance: 2 damage to a random enemy. Final Bow: 1 damage to a random enemy Crew member.
flavor: The house always wins. Larry IS the house.

name: Mana Wisp
text: Entrance: Gain 1 Mana this turn only.
flavor: It hums when the homework is due.

name: Study Group
text: Entrance: Summon a 1/1 Study Buddy.
flavor: Three heads are better than one. Four is a study group.
